description: ADO-ASYNC with a genuinely blocked statement: peer b holds an open transaction that updated K row 1; process a calls Connection.Execute of an UPDATE of row 1 with adAsyncExecute|adExecuteNoRecords (Connection State right after, and after timestamped pauses of 500, 2000 and 5000 ms, Errors each time); then a second blocked async call is Cancelled at once (Cancel result, States, Errors); b then rolls back and a runs the UPDATE again. Asks whether the pending state tracks a lock wait, what Cancel does to it and what the error is.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
